main.description: Check a release against the rules the indexer applies, and optionally write it to the caller's repo. The indexer validates a record only after it is published and skips an invalid one quietly, so a publisher writing the record itself gets no feedback; this answers the same refusal before the record exists. Pass validateOnly to check a record without writing it. Like every XRPC procedure this needs an authenticated caller, so validateOnly is a dry run rather than an anonymous one.

record.description: An at.happyproto.plugin.release record. Its package and version decide the record key, as the record lexicon requires of them.

validateOnly.description: Check the record and write nothing. Still requires authentication, as every procedure does.

valid.description: Always true; an invalid record is an error, not a result.

uri.description: The record written. Absent when validateOnly was set.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The caller's identity could not be determined, so there is no publisher to check the profile against and no repo to write to.

errors.name: InvalidRecord
errors.description: The record is not a release the indexer would accept. The message names the reason.

errors.name: VersionExists
errors.description: That version is already published, or was withdrawn. A version is immutable once released and never reusable; publish a new one.

errors.name: ProfileMissing
errors.description: No profile is indexed at that slug, so the release would index against nothing.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: The record could not be written to the caller's repo.

errors.name: NotConfigured
errors.description: The registry has no identity configured.
